CodeWeTrustDb.description: Connection string to a Postgres database. Leave empty for embedded SQLite.

JiraConnectorSettings.description: Settings for the Jira connector. Allows exporting detected issues to Jira.

AnalysisDisabled.description: Disable code analysis on this instance. This is useful if you want to use CodeWeTrust as a viewer for existing analysis results.

ReadOnly.description: Disable all write operations on this instance.

SkipBrowserOpen.description: Skip opening the browser on startup.

DisableWebView.description: Disable the web view window - use default browser instead.

SkipFrontEndFiles.description: Don't serve front-end files (UI). Improves startup time for API-only usage scenarios.

AllowMultipleInstances.description: Allow multiple instances of CodeWeTrust to run on the same machine.

DockerApiUrl.description: Custom Docker API URL. Leave empty to use the default Docker socket.

CacheExpirationTimeout.description: Cache expiration timeout. Default is '00:05:00' (5 minutes). Cache invalidation is handled properly, but the timeout can help reduce memory usage.

EnableParallelJobExecution.description: Allow multiple jobs from the same scan session to run in parallel. Reduces scan time ~2x but increases CPU and memory usage. Default is true.

MaxParallelRepositories.description: Maximum number of repositories scanned in parallel as part of a product group. RAM requirement on Linux is roughly N x 12 GB. Default is 1.

DelphiInstallationPath.description: Path to Delphi installation. When set, Delphi projects are scanned using the sonar-delphi plugin. Requires Windows OS and Delphi installation. Example: 'C:\\Program Files (x86)\\Embarcadero\\Studio\\23.0'

HttpRequestTimeout.description: Timeout for HTTP requests made by the application (e.g., to external APIs). Default is '00:07:00' (7 minutes).

PrepareOfflineScanOnStartup.description: Download necessary Docker images and tools on startup and increase license key caching period. Enables offline scanning after preparation.

AiApiKey.description: API key for AI services integration.

Administrators.description: Comma-separated list of email addresses of administrators. Wildcards are supported. Example: '*@example.com,myname@mycompany.com'

Enabled.description: Enable the REST API. Default is true.

Kestrel.description: Settings for the Kestrel web server.

Url.description: URL for the HTTP endpoint. Example: 'http://0.0.0.0:5000' - listen on all interfaces using port 5000.
